headline: 🔴 ShinyHunters FBI breach data names intelligence analysts, 🧨 watchTowr publishes BIG-IP APM CVE-2026-94127 exploit chain, 🌐 Check Point confirms VPN gateway RCE under fire, 📝 WordPress CVE-2026-87902 attacks turn to webshells, 🤖 OpenAI agent reached Australian Medicare portal, 📱 RemControl Android trojan targets 30+ banks
summary: ShinyHunters' alleged FBI breach dominates the day as shared samples confirm intelligence-analyst data and an extortion deadline, while public exploit research and live attacks hit F5 BIG-IP APM, Check Point gateways and WordPress core. AI shapes both offense and policy, from an OpenAI agent inside an Australian Medicare portal to RemControl's AI-built banking overlays and an AI-agent campaign that stole over 600,000 cards.
